text:
Which statement about a converging lens is not correct?
A
A ray parallel to the principal axis of the lens is refracted through the principal focus.
B
All rays of light refracted by the lens pass through the principal focus.
C
The distance between the centre of the lens and the principal focus is the focal length.
D
The principal focus of the lens is a point on the principal axis.

options.label: A
options.text: A ray parallel to the principal axis of the lens is refracted through the principal focus.

options.label: B
options.text: All rays of light refracted by the lens pass through the principal focus.

options.label: C
options.text: The distance between the centre of the lens and the principal focus is the focal length.

options.label: D
options.text: The principal focus of the lens is a point on the principal axis.
